notes: No accepted C++ submission (the three recorded ones are RTE). orig.cpp was written for the corpus: a tree DP that merges children left to right, keeping the partial cycle as paths over the subtree's top node and its first and last K leaves, deciding each ring edge at the merge that first joins its leaves and the wrap-around ones at the root. It matches an exhaustive Hamiltonian-cycle brute on 500 generated cases with n <= 11, 131 of the first 300 with a nonzero count.
